title: Binance spot pairs with at least one recorded trade per UTC day
definition: Each distinct spot symbol contributes once per UTC date with a 1d kline having number_of_trades > 0. All quote assets covered. No fill or interpolation.
scope_limitation: Observed trading activity in the public sources; historical trading eligibility, suspensions without trades, and missing source records are not inferred.

local_raw_crosscheck.rule: Compare dates with a positive number of trades against repository raw daily kline CSVs.

collection_parameters.next_page: After a full page, add 86400000 to the last open timestamp. Stop at a shorter page or after the end time. For an archived symbol without API candles, read available 1d archive files within the range.
